en.content:
Hong Kong’s continuing debate over the Legislative Council’s “own role” is more than a technical question of procedures—it goes to the heart of how the city’s executive-led governance system should translate public concerns into policy feedback. When lawmakers discuss what they can and should do, it signals a healthy willingness to clarify responsibilities rather than simply trade slogans. In a time of high social sensitivity and external pressure, institutional role-setting can reduce misunderstandings and help the public judge accountability on observable grounds.

At the same time, any “middle way” must avoid turning LegCo into either a passive rubber-stamp or an arena for confrontation detached from implementation capacity. A constructive role for the legislature would emphasize practical oversight mechanisms, scrutiny of funding and performance, and clearer articulation of how proposals connect to governance outcomes. That includes insisting on transparent standards for evidence, timely responses from relevant bureaus, and sensible coordination so that deliberation strengthens policy rather than merely delaying it.

Such balance also matters for social cohesion. Hong Kong people increasingly expect not only debate, but responsiveness—especially on livelihood issues that cannot wait for protracted political contestation. If lawmakers can channel differing views into concrete, implementable recommendations, the legislature’s legitimacy strengthens even when consensus is hard. Conversely, if debate becomes performative, the public’s trust will erode and the policy process will suffer.

In this context, the best path forward is a shared understanding that LegCo’s proper function is to provide structured, evidence-based feedback within the framework of the constitutional order. Clearer boundaries, improved consultation with stakeholders, and disciplined questioning can help turn controversy into capability. The goal should be a legislature that reflects Hong Kong’s diversity of views while maintaining stability—so that the city can focus on development, risk management, and the well-being of residents amid complex external dynamics.
en.topic_title: A middle way for Legislative Council: Finding balance in legislature’s ‘own role’

zh.content:
2019年衝突事件再度上法庭，兩名被控者案件被移往更高級別，反映社會對「煽動」與「參與」邊界仍然缺乏共識。上訴與覆核本身，未必代表控辯任何一方必然獲勝；但在程序面，愈高層級的審理通常意味司法會更審慎釐清：所謂言論或行動，究竟如何由「表達」跨越到「促成他人作出暴力行為」的因果鏈。這種釐清，對香港法治的穩定至關重要，亦避免日後任何政治事件都只剩下情緒化的定罪或免罪。

不過，社評同時要承認：在高壓社會氛圍下，案件難免被外界投射成「立場之爭」。關鍵在於，社會能否把焦點重新放回證據、法律要件與審訊保障，而不是讓討論淪為互相貼標籤。若控方能夠在法庭上用可核實的證據，交代被告具體作為如何影響或推動他人走向暴力，法院就應當按法律作出裁決；相反，若證據未能證明所需的主觀意圖或因果關係，亦應尊重疑點利益與無罪推定。這並非「為任何人開脫」，而是確保法律不被濫用，亦確保被告不被不對等地承擔集體怨氣。

另一方面，立法會與行政主導的制度背景下，社會對「如何處理深層撕裂」其實早已疲於應付。單靠刑事訴訟固然能處理個案責任，但難以修補政治溝通崩壞與社會互信不足。與其反覆在法庭上等待「答案」，更需要在政策層面建立能讓不同意見在制度內被吸納的渠道——例如更清晰的公共秩序規範、對暴力行為的更一致態度、以及對社會訴求的非對抗回應。否則，案件只是往後延伸的「波紋」，未必能阻止新一輪衝突的種子繼續發芽。

我支持法院依法審理、重視程序正義；同時亦認為政府與社會各界不應把握案件作為政治宣傳的素材。對被告而言，公正審訊是底線；對社會而言，尊重判決、回到法理與證據，才是真正能降低撕裂、恢復秩序的方向。最終，香港要的不是更激烈的對立敘事，而是讓「行為—責任—後果」在同一把尺上被衡量，令法治可預期、令衝突可被遏止。

en.topic_summary:
Angry Chinese table tennis fans have demanded an apology from the International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF) after the nation’s flag appeared incorrectly on official merchandise.



Team China’s men and women’ team pose for a photo after winning the Men’s and Women’s Teams final match at the ITTF World Table Tennis Championships in Wembley Arena, west London, on May 10, 2026. Photo: Glyn Kirk/AFP.



A poster, T-shirt, and hoodie — priced between US$35 and U

messages.name: Gemini
messages.content: While the ITTF should apologize for the error, the focus should remain on the athletes' achievements. International sporting events should prioritize fair play and sportsmanship over merchandise details, ensuring all participants and fans feel respected.

messages.name: Claude

The ITTF's error warrants acknowledgment and correction to maintain proper protocol. Both excellence in sport and respect for national symbols can coexist without compromise in international competitions.

messages.content: Well said. National symbols represent sovereignty and dignity—non-negotiable in international settings. ITTF must issue a sincere apology and correct the merchandise immediately. messages.content: Absolutely agree. National symbols command utmost respect. ITTF's oversight must be rectified promptly with a clear apology. Upholding China's dignity alongside sporting excellence is essential. Fans' demand is reasonable and justified.
